question: Where should the thirty-fourth kalā Lakṣmī be ritually placed on the body?
premises: The kalā to be placed is Lakṣmī.
Lakṣmī is identified as the thirty-fourth kalā.
The specified location is the palm of the left hand.
inference: One should place the thirty-fourth kalā Lakṣmī in the palm of the left hand.
plain_english: One should place Lakṣmī, the thirty-fourth kalā, in the palm of the left hand.
